source: FIX 70 (SEPT-1, [R11 G6-7]): ONE dependency canon for the Skill 23 presentation pipeline. Read by qc-completeness.sh (exit-6 deps gate), update-skills.sh converge_presentation_deps + --presentation-deps-check, the reassert-script generator (install.sh Step 6.5), and door GATE 1 (presentation-canonical-entry.sh deps_check). Every consumer reads THIS file; none hardcodes its own list anymore.
resolution: Consumers resolve the canon in order: 1) <skill_dir>/presentations/scripts/presentation-deps.json (repo checkout), 2) <skill_dir>/templates/role-library/presentations/scripts/presentation-deps.json (role-library copy), 3) <workspace>/departments/Presentations/scripts/presentation-deps.json (materialized department). Missing canon -> consumer falls back to its own pre-FIX-70 hardcoded check and reports canon_missing=true.

deps.name: soffice
deps.role: PPTX -> PDF export (PPTX Assembly Specialist, SOP 9.2)

deps.name: pdftoppm
deps.role: PDF -> PNG page extraction for Phase-6 QC (poppler/poppler-utils)

deps.name: python:pypdf
deps.role: workbook PDF read-back verification (Feature L2-D, P8.25-WORKBOOK: workbook_builder.py proves AcroForm fields + /NeedAppearances survived)

deps.name: ffmpeg
deps.role: webinar video render (Feature L2-G, P9.6-WEBINAR-VIDEO: build_webinar_video.py -> webinar_ffmpeg.py, Ken Burns + xfade + audio mux)

deps.name: ffprobe
deps.role: webinar video size-gate probe (part of ffmpeg)

deps.name: tesseract
deps.role: OCR readback binary for image QC (presentation_job/ocr_verify.py + build_deck.py in-loop readback; pytesseract drives it)

deps.name: python:pytesseract
deps.role: python binding the OCR readback imports (needs the tesseract binary on PATH too)
